title: Approximating the top monomial approximates every function
statement: Let $K$ be a finite field and fix $\omega \in K$ with $\omega \neq 0$, and let $n$ be a natural number. Suppose that every function $f\colon \{1,\omega\}^n \to K$ agrees, at every point of the cube $\{1,\omega\}^n$, with some squarefree polynomial $\sum_{S \subseteq \{1,\dots,n\}} c_S \prod_{i \in S} X_i$ over $K$. If a polynomial $P$ in $n$ variables over $K$ has total degree at most $d$ and disagrees with the top monomial $x \mapsto \prod_{i} x_i$ on at most $e$ points of $\{1,\omega\}^n$, then every function $f\colon \{1,\omega\}^n \to K$ admits a polynomial $Q$ of total degree at most $\lfloor n/2 \rfloor + d$ that disagrees with $f$ on at most $e$ points of the cube.
